text:
nina: Heads-up I opened a PR to modernize the onboarding quickstart: switch to SDK9 preview snippets (async), add a tiny edge-deploy note, and simplify auth examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901
rashid: Nice. What's the compatibility story for SDK9? We should add a single line about pinning to SDK8 for stable teams.
nina: Good call. Added a short compatibility note: "SDK9 is backwards-compatible for basic generate/embed calls, but pin SDK8 for production until GA."
build-bot: CI started for PR #901: running build, linkcheck, and snippet-tests.
mia: One quick nit — the curl snippet still shows `--header "auth: ..."`. Please canonicalize to `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Also, add a tiny example showing env var usage in Dockerfile: `ENV RW_API_KEY=${RW_API_KEY}`.
zoe: Snippet portability: the setup step uses `perl -pi -e` for in-place replace. That breaks on some minimal containers. Suggest replacing with a short node one-liner or `python -c` variant.
nina: Switched the replace to a Node cross-platform snippet and left a comment: "Requires node or python; pick whichever is available." Pushed commit.
rashid: Also add a brief blurb about short-lived keys and KMS -> link to /security/kms. Enterprise folks will ask.
nina: Added 1-line KMS pointer and an example sentence about swapping keys with zero-downtime if env reloaders are used.
build-bot: snippet-tests failed on macOS: the example uses `chmod +x ./entrypoint.sh` followed by `./entrypoint.sh` which triggers shellcheck in CI. Log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/901/snippet-log.
mia: The shellcheck failure is because entrypoint.sh has `set -eu` but references an undefined var in a conditional. Quick fix: guard with `${VAR:-}` or check with `if [ -n "${VAR:-}" ]`.
zoe: Content LGTM otherwise. Tiny style nit: change heading "Getting started now" -> "Getting started" to match docs style.
nina: Fixed shell script, updated heading, and pushed. Re-running CI.
build-bot: All checks passed for PR #901. Mergeable.
mia: Approved from devex. Thanks for handling the Node fallback.
rashid: Merging after site build. Can someone sanity-check the live quickstart after deploy?
zoe: I'll do a quick run on staging and report back if anything breaks.
build-bot: Site build and deploy to staging succeeded for PR 901.
zoe: Verified staging quickstart: ran the sample app locally, auth flow and Docker notes worked. Found one tiny wording tweak in the edge hint; pushed a micro-fix to the site branch.
nina: Amazing — thanks team :tada: Closing this thread.
